'''Darth Perash''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Per" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] spent [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] building an elaborate [[Darth Perash's tomb|tomb]], often ordering the workers to tear down everything they had done and start over. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], scavengers searched through the latest rubble from the tomb's construction and salvaged construction materials and items Perash had overlooked.<ref name="Per" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Perash was first mentioned as part of the scavenging crew skills mission "Perfectionist" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The mission did not make clear Perash's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] or [[Species/Legends|species]] but the German mission description indicates that Darth Perash is [[Gender/Legends|female]].<ref name="Per" />
